SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu: Yodl Buffer Over-Read DoS     
                                        
  An input validation issue causes a    
  memory buffer over-read during        
  document parsing in Yodl. Specially   
  crafted files trigger process crashes,
  enabling remote denial of service     
  conditions.                           
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
